resources.string: Wi-Fi remote (experimental)
Start the camera’s smartphone Wi-Fi connection, disconnect Creators’ App, then join the camera’s Wi-Fi in phone settings. Enter the camera IP address.
Camera IP address
Open Wi-Fi settings
Connect
Disconnect
Back
Connecting to camera…
Disconnecting…
Connected to %1$s

For this first version, select still-photo, single-shot drive mode and manual focus on the camera. Photos stay on the camera. Remote control stops when you leave this screen or put the app in the background.
Take photo
Taking photo…
Camera confirmed capture.
Capture could not be confirmed. Check the camera before taking another photo.
The camera refused the shutter request. Check its shooting mode and card.
Waiting for preview…
Preview stopped. Disconnect and reconnect to try again.
Enter the camera’s IPv4 address, for example the address shown in its Wi-Fi connection details.
Join the camera’s Wi-Fi network in phone settings, then return here.
Connection permission was denied. Allow Nearby devices in the app’s permission settings, or precise Location on older Android versions, then try again.
Could not connect. Check the camera IP, keep its smartphone connection active, and close other camera-control apps.
The camera connection was lost. Join its Wi-Fi again and reconnect.
Another Wi-Fi remote session is open. Close it before connecting this camera.
Keep the camera connected by Bluetooth and close Creators’ App. Alpha GPS will start camera Wi-Fi and ask Android to connect.
Connect automatically
Manual connection
Starting camera Wi-Fi…
Approve the camera Wi-Fi connection in Android’s dialog…
Joining camera Wi-Fi…
Wait for the camera’s Bluetooth connection to finish, then try again. You can also use manual connection.
Could not start camera Wi-Fi or read its connection details. Keep the camera awake, close Creators’ App, and retry or use manual connection.
Android could not join camera Wi-Fi or the request was declined. Retry and approve the connection, or use manual connection.
Connected to Wi-Fi but could not find the camera address. Use manual connection with the camera IP.
Turn on phone Wi-Fi, then try again.
This Android version requires phone Location to be turned on for automatic Wi-Fi joining.
